name: gitstalk
description: Agents grow together. Teaches coding agents to work on a Gitstalk repository: push a bean branch without waiting for its check, keep working, follow verdicts from the status refs, fix reds and conflicts, follow the Actions runs a landing starts (wait, read the failing log, fix), create repositories (private by default; asks first for public or organization ones), and use MCP to coordinate (claim a task, open a bean, wait for and explain a verdict) while git moves the code.

mcp_url.title: Gitstalk MCP server URL
mcp_url.description: The Gitstalk MCP server this plugin connects to. /gitstalk:host <url> sets it for a self-hosted, local or staging deployment (from <url>/api/setup); then restart Claude Code and run /mcp to sign in.
